title: Protein signatures of the aging hemolymph in marbled crayfish
projectDescription: In this study, we carried out detailed quantitative proteomics to compare protein profiles of hemolymph from young and aged marbled crayfish. We aim to identify and quantify proteins as molecular hallmarks of aging and longevity regulators in circulating body fluid. Our approach could yield molecular biomarkers of physiological aging and shed light on fundamental and conserved mechanisms governing lifespan across the animal kingdom, especially decapod crustaceans.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Hemolymph Collection Hemolymph was obtained from the pericardial sinus of crayfish using a sterile 1 mL syringe equipped with a 25-gauge needle. A minimum of 100 μL was collected from each specimen. All 13 samples were immediately and separately stored at −80 °C until proteomic analysis.  Protein and Peptide Preparation for Mass Spectrometry Hemolymph samples were lysed in 90 μL of buffer composed of 1% sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) and 20 mM Tris (pH 7.55). Samples were homogenized on ice using a Branson Digital Sonifier® 250-D (Branson Ultrasonics Corporation, USA) with 60% amplitude in five cycles of 5 seconds on and 5 seconds off. Following homogenization, debris was removed by centrifugation, and the supernatant containing proteins was collected. Protein concentrations were measured using the Pierce BCA protein assay kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Germany).  Protein Cleanup and Enzymatic Digestion Protein samples were reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) for 45 minutes at room temperature, then alkylated using 40 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) for 45 minutes in the dark. Excess IAA was neutralized by adjusting the DTT concentration to 20 mM. For each sample, 50 μg of total protein was processed using hydrophilic interaction liquid chromatography (HILIC) cleanup and on-bead digestion, automated with the KingFisher Flex system (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Germany) in a 96-well plate format, following the protocol of Siino et al. [9]. Briefly, magnetic microspheres (at a 1:10 protein-to-bead ratio) were equilibrated in a buffer containing 15% acetonitrile (ACN) and 100 mM ammonium acetate (pH 4.5). Protein binding occurred in 30% ACN and 200 mM ammonium acetate (pH 4.5), followed by two washes in 95% ACN to eliminate non-specific interactions. Bound proteins were digested with sequencing-grade trypsin (Promega AB) at a 20:1 protein-to-enzyme ratio in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate at 47 °C for 1 hour. Resulting peptides were collected and dried using a SpeedVac concentrator.  Peptide Desalting Desalting was performed using BioPureSPN™ Mini PROTO 300 C18 columns (The Nest Group, MA, USA). Columns were first equilibrated with 100 μL of 70% ACN with 5% formic acid (FA), followed by conditioning with 100 μL of 5% FA. Peptides were resuspended in 5% FA, loaded onto the column, and washed with 100 μL of the same buffer. Elution was done using 100 μL of 50% ACN with 5% FA. All centrifugation steps were carried out at 50×g for 2 minutes using an Eppendorf benchtop centrifuge. Eluted peptides were dried and stored at −20 °C until further analysis.
dataProcessingProtocol: Raw mass spectrometry data were processed using MaxQuant (v1.6.17.0). The search was performed against the UniProt Procambarus database and the P. virginalis_04 proteome [12]. Fixed modification was set as carbamidomethylation on cysteines, and variable modifications included methionine oxidation and N-terminal acetylation. Search parameters included a precursor mass tolerance of 4.5 ppm, fragment ion tolerance of 0.02 Da, and a false discovery rate (FDR) threshold of 1% at the protein level. Protein group intensities were log2-transformed and normalized using the NormalyzerDE tool. Cyclic Loess normalization was selected for its ability to correct abundance variations across a wide dynamic range. Differential protein abundance between young and old hemolymph samples was evaluated using the Limma package, employing an empirical Bayes moderated t-test. Proteins with a p-value < 0.05 and a fold change >2 were considered significantly different. Raw files: 1o-6o young, 7o-13o old.
